papers.title: Diagnostic Value in Discarded Reads: Re-evaluating Multi-Mapping cfDNA Fragmentomics and GC Bias in Early-Stage Cancer.
papers.translated_title: 废弃读段中的诊断价值：重新评估早期癌症中多比对cfDNA片段组学与GC偏倚
papers.author: UPPALURI, K. R.
papers.summary: Background. Low-coverage plasma cell-free DNA (cfDNA) sequencing is an inexpensive substrate for cancer detection. Standard pipelines discard fragments with low mapping quality, which originate mostly from repetitive DNA, although pericentromeric satellite repeats are frequently hypomethylated in cancer. We asked whether the fraction of multi-mapping cfDNA fragments differs between early-stage cancer and matched healthy controls, and how it compares with conventional fragmentomic features under strict control of technical factors. Methods. We analysed public plasma cfDNA whole-genome sequencing from 25 patients with stage I to III breast cancer and 25 healthy controls matched 1:1 for age, sex, smoking and alcohol use, each pair processed in the same library and sequencing batch, and from 8 early-stage hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) cases with 8 matched controls. For every sample we computed the fraction of autosomal fragments with MAPQ < 30 and the share of these fragments located in centromeric and heterochromatic cytobands, and related them to stage, grade and copy-number deviation as proxies of tumour burden. Classifiers were evaluated by leave-one-pair-out cross-validation in breast cancer and, trained on breast cancer only, applied unchanged to HCC. Robustness to GC content and sequencing depth was tested by within-fold residualisation and by fragment-level GC weighting. Conventional fragmentomic features (fragment length, end motifs, copy number, DELFI-like profiles and window features at transcription start sites) were evaluated under four GC-handling analyses. Results. The multi-mapping fraction was higher in breast cancer than in matched controls (median 5.38 % vs 5.19 %; higher in 19/25 pairs; paired p = 0.0006; cross-validated AUC 0.81, 95 % CI 0.67 - 0.94), in stage I (9/10 pairs), stage II (7/10) and stage III (3/5) disease and in every sequencing batch. The excess was concentrated in centromeric and heterochromatic bands, whose share of multi-mapping fragments rose from 22.0 % to 23.4 % (19/25 pairs; p = 0.004). Both signals persisted after within-fold adjustment for GC content and/or depth (AUC 0.64 - 0.76 for the multi-mapping fraction, 0.71 - 0.76 for the heterochromatic share) and under fragment-level GC weighting (18/25 pairs; p = 0.003). The multi-mapping difference was largest in stage I and decreased with stage (Spearman {rho} = -0.42, p = 0.04), and neither feature was associated with grade or copy-number deviation. In public tissue methylomes, satellites were hypomethylated in breast tumours to a similar extent as other late-replicating DNA, but the bin-level association between tumour hypomethylation and the cfDNA excess was weak and was explained by GC content. In HCC, the pre-specified endpoint, the breast-trained multi-mapping model, was not met (AUC 0.73; 5/8 pairs; sign test p = 0.36). In an exploratory analysis that was not pre-specified, the heterochromatic share was higher in 7/8 HCC pairs (p = 0.016; locked AUC 0.86, 95 % CI 0.62 - 1.00); across all 33 pairs, including the discovery pairs, it was higher in the cancer case in 26 (post hoc sign test p = 0.0007). In contrast, conventional fragmentomic features reached AUC 0.71 (breast) and 0.77 (HCC) only without fragment-level GC control; they tracked the per-sample coverage GC dependence and fell to chance under each of three GC-controlled analyses, including one that preserves promoter-specific signal. Conclusions. Multi-mapping cfDNA fragments, which are routinely discarded, differed between early-stage breast cancer and batch-matched controls, largely independently of GC content and sequencing depth, with an excess in centromeric and heterochromatic DNA. The signal did not scale with stage, its biological origin is unproven, and a read-quality contribution cannot be excluded from fragment files. It is a candidate marker that requires confirmation in larger cohorts with raw reads and tumour-fraction estimates.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。低覆盖度的血浆游离DNA（cfDNA）测序是一种廉价的癌症检测底物。标准流程会丢弃比对质量低的片段，这些片段主要来源于重复DNA，尽管在癌症中近着丝粒卫星重复序列常呈低甲基化。我们探究了多比对cfDNA片段的比例在早期癌症与匹配的健康对照之间是否存在差异，以及在严格控制技术因素的条件下其与常规片段组学特征的比较情况。方法。我们分析了来自25例I至III期乳腺癌患者和25例健康对照的公开血浆cfDNA全基因组测序数据，对照按年龄、性别、吸烟和饮酒情况1：1匹配，每对样本在同一文库和测序批次中处理；另分析了8例早期肝细胞癌（HCC）病例及8例匹配对照。对每个样本，我们计算了MAPQ < 30的常染色体片段比例以及这些片段位于着丝粒和异染色质细胞带中的份额，并将其与分期、分级和拷贝数偏差（作为肿瘤负荷的替代指标）相关联。分类器在乳腺癌中通过留一对交叉验证进行评估，并仅在乳腺癌上训练后原样应用于HCC。通过折内残差化和片段级GC加权检验了对GC含量和测序深度的稳健性。常规片段组学特征（片段长度、末端基序、拷贝数、类DELFI图谱和转录起始位点窗口特征）在四种GC处理分析下进行评估。结果。多比对片段比例在乳腺癌中高于匹配对照（中位数5.38 % vs 5.19 %；19/25对中更高；配对p = 0.0006；交叉验证AUC 0.81，95 % CI 0.67 - 0.94），在I期（9/10对）、II期（7/10）和III期（3/5）疾病中以及每个测序批次中均如此。该超额集中于着丝粒和异染色质带，其多比对片段份额从22.0 %升至23.4 %（19/25对；p = 0.004）。两种信号在折内校正GC含量和/或深度后持续存在（多比对片段AUC 0.64 - 0.76，异染色质份额AUC 0.71 - 0.76），在片段级GC加权下亦持续存在（18/25对；p = 0.003）。多比对差异在I期最大并随分期降低（Spearman {rho} = -0.42，p = 0.04），两种特征均与分级或拷贝数偏差无关。在公开组织甲基化组中，卫星序列在乳腺肿瘤中的低甲基化程度与其他晚复制DNA相似，但肿瘤低甲基化与cfDNA超额之间的区间级关联较弱，且可由GC含量解释。在HCC中，预设终点、乳腺癌训练的多比对模型未达到（AUC 0.73；5/8对；符号检验p = 0.36）。在一项未预设的探索性分析中，异染色质份额在7/8的HCC对中更高（p = 0.016；锁定AUC 0.86，95 % CI 0.62 - 1.00）；在包括发现对在内的全部33对中，癌症病例中有26对更高（事后符号检验p = 0.0007）。相比之下，常规片段组学特征仅在无片段级GC控制时达到AUC 0.71（乳腺癌）和0.77（HCC）；它们跟随每样本覆盖度的GC依赖性，并在三种GC控制分析（包括一种保留启动子特异性信号的分析）中的每一种下均降至随机水平。结论。常规被丢弃的多比对cfDNA片段在早期乳腺癌与批次匹配对照之间存在差异，很大程度上独立于GC含量和测序深度，且在着丝粒和异染色质DNA中呈超额。该信号不随分期缩放，其生物学来源尚未证实，且不能从片段文件中排除读段质量的贡献。它是一个候选标志物，需要在具有原始读段和肿瘤分数估计的更大队列中加以确认。

papers.title: ShortKit-ML: an open toolkit for measuring shortcut potential in medical imaging embeddings
papers.translated_title: ShortKit-ML：一个用于测量医学影像嵌入中捷径潜力的开放工具包
papers.author: Cajas, S.
papers.summary: Background and Objective: A classifier trained on frozen embeddings can take a shortcut through a sensitive attribute only if the embedding carries information about it beyond what the task label explains: its shortcut potential. We asked whether this can be measured on the embedding alone with a known false positive rate, and whether it predicts how strongly a classifier trained on confounded data relies on the attribute. Methods: ShortKit-ML tests whether an embedding E and a sensitive attribute A are dependent given a task label Y. The primary test is a condi- tional probe: a logistic regression that predicts A from E and Y, scored by out-of-fold AUROC and calibrated by permuting A within levels of Y, be- tween patients. Five secondary detectors share this null. We audited sex, age and race for seven frozen encoders on CheXpert and four on MIMIC-CXR, and trained heads on confounded CheXpert splits. Results: Under the null the probe rejected in 0.02 of synthetic data sets. With A and Y strongly correlated, an unconditional probe rejected in 0.95 and the conditional probe in 0.03. No detector found signals that leave group means unchanged, unlike probes on squared or product features under the same null. The probe found attribute information in 21 of 21 CheXpert and 12 of 12 MIMIC-CXR cells. Across 42 CheXpert cells the probe score correlated with the true positive rate gap of a confounded head (Spearman 0.60, 95% CI 0.31 to 0.80 resampling encoders), 0.74 within sex and not significantly within age. Three embedding-level mitigations changed the gap by at most 0.01 relative to their controls. Refitting the head on a group-balanced subset closed it. A planted image marker was found in all 10 seeds. Conclusions: One calibrated linear test measures shortcut potential on a frozen embedding, and on CheXpert its score correlated with how strongly a confounded logistic head relied on the attribute, clearly for sex. It does not show that a given head uses the attribute, and lowering the score did not remove reliance, so the head itself must be tested as well. Code is at https://github.com/criticaldata/ShortKit-ML.
papers.translated_summary: 背景与目标：在冻结嵌入上训练的分类器，只有当嵌入携带了超出任务标签所能解释的敏感属性信息时，才能通过该敏感属性走捷径：这就是其捷径潜力。我们探究了能否仅凭嵌入本身、以已知的假阳性率来测量这一潜力，以及它是否能预测在混杂数据上训练的分类器对该属性的依赖程度。方法：ShortKit-ML 检验嵌入 E 与敏感属性 A 在给定任务标签 Y 的条件下是否相关。主要检验是条件探针：一个从 E 和 Y 预测 A 的逻辑回归，以折外 AUROC 评分，并通过在患者之间于 Y 的各水平内置换 A 进行校准。五个次级检测器共享这一零假设。我们在 CheXpert 的七个冻结编码器和 MIMIC-CXR 的四个冻结编码器上审计了性别、年龄和种族，并在混杂的 CheXpert 划分上训练了头部。结果：在零假设下，探针在 0.02 的合成数据集中拒绝。当 A 与 Y 强相关时，无条件探针在 0.95 的情况下拒绝，而条件探针在 0.03 的情况下拒绝。没有检测器发现使组均值保持不变信号，这与在同一零假设下对平方或乘积特征的探针不同。探针在 21 个 CheXpert 单元中的 21 个和 12 个 MIMIC-CXR 单元中的 12 个中发现了属性信息。在 42 个 CheXpert 单元中，探针得分与混杂头部的真阳性率差距相关（Spearman 0.60，95% CI 0.31 至 0.80，重采样编码器），在性别内为 0.74，在年龄内不显著。三种嵌入层面的缓解措施相对于其对照最多将差距改变 0.01。在组平衡子集上重新拟合头部消除了该差距。在所有 10 个种子中都发现了植入的图像标记。结论：一个校准的线性检验可在冻结嵌入上测量捷径潜力，并且在 CheXpert 上其得分与混杂逻辑头部对该属性的依赖程度相关，对性别尤为明显。它并不表明某个给定头部使用了该属性，而且降低得分并未消除依赖，因此头部本身也必须被检验。代码见 https://github.com/criticaldata/ShortKit-ML。

papers.title: Dense Breast Tissue Segmentation under Limited Annotation: Comparing CNNs, Transformers, Self-Supervision, and Prompting
papers.translated_title: 有限标注下的致密乳腺组织分割：比较CNN、Transformer、自监督与提示方法
papers.author: Qu, B.
papers.summary: Dense breast tissue reduces the sensitivity of mammographic screening and is an important risk factor for breast cancer, making accurate dense-tissue segmentation particularly important when expert pixel-level annotations are limited. We empirically study dense breast tissue segmentation under limited pixel-level supervision using a small expert-annotated dataset (596 images) together with an in-domain unlabeled mammography dataset (20{,}000 images). We compare classical pixel-level segmentation methods, CNN and U-Net encoder--decoder models, transformer-based models, self-supervised pre-training, fine-tuning strategies, loss functions, and prompt-based MedSAM variants under a unified evaluation protocol. CNN-based models achieve the best standalone segmentation performance while providing the most favorable balance between accuracy and computational cost. In contrast, the adaptive fuzzy c-means + SVM baseline and transformer-based models perform worse in this low-label setting. Our analysis of prompt-based MedSAM further shows that SAM-style models are highly sensitive to prompt quality. Box and breast-region prompts lead to poor performance, whereas CNN-generated dense prompts substantially improve MedSAM performance. However, even with mask-decoder fine-tuning, CNN-prompted MedSAM does not outperform the best standalone CNN model, suggesting that current SAM-style models require stronger prompts or adaptation beyond the mask decoder for diffuse breast-density segmentation. Additionally, a density-calibrated hybrid loss primarily improves percent-density calibration by reducing the test MAE from 14.8 to 11.8 percentage points. Our computational cost analysis indicates that many generic self-supervised learning and parameter-efficient adaptation strategies provide limited practical benefit relative to their additional cost. These findings offer practical guidance for developing reproducible dense breast tissue segmentation models in mammography studies with limited labeled data.
papers.translated_summary: 致密乳腺组织会降低乳腺X线摄影筛查的敏感性，并且是乳腺癌的重要风险因素，因此在专家像素级标注有限的情况下，准确的致密组织分割尤为重要。我们利用一个小的专家标注数据集（596张图像）以及一个域内未标注乳腺X线摄影数据集（20,000张图像），在有限的像素级监督下对致密乳腺组织分割进行实证研究。我们在统一的评估协议下比较了经典像素级分割方法、CNN和U-Net编码器--解码器模型、基于Transformer的模型、自监督预训练、微调策略、损失函数以及基于提示的MedSAM变体。基于CNN的模型取得了最佳的独立分割性能，同时在准确性与计算成本之间提供了最有利的平衡。相比之下，自适应模糊c均值+SVM基线以及基于Transformer的模型在这种低标注设置下表现较差。我们对基于提示的MedSAM的分析进一步表明，SAM风格的模型对提示质量高度敏感。框提示和乳腺区域提示导致性能较差，而CNN生成的致密提示则显著提升了MedSAM的性能。然而，即使经过掩码解码器微调，CNN提示的MedSAM仍未超越最佳的独立CNN模型，这表明当前的SAM风格模型在弥漫性乳腺密度分割中需要更强的提示或超越掩码解码器的适配。此外，一种密度校准的混合损失主要通过将测试MAE从14.8个百分点降低到11.8个百分点来改善百分比密度校准。我们的计算成本分析表明，许多通用的自监督学习和参数高效适配策略相对于其额外成本而言提供的实际收益有限。这些发现为在标注数据有限的乳腺X线摄影研究中开发可复现的致密乳腺组织分割模型提供了实用指导。
